lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- Dollars and Reais
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 7 -- Dollars and Reais
lesson.grammar_point: present simple questions with do / does + short answers

listenings.text: Good morning. This is the exchange desk. Today the dollar is five reais and twenty cents. We buy at five reais and ten cents, and we sell at five reais and thirty cents. The desk is open from nine in the morning to five in the afternoon. For a big operation, please call your manager. Thank you, and have a good day.

Hi Ricardo, this is Sarah Klein, from Delta Foods. We import coffee machines from Italy, and we pay in euros. Do you work with euros too, or only with dollars? And what is the price today? My company needs the money on Friday, not next week. Please call me back this morning. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: A client calls the bank in the morning. She asks the price of the dollar. I say the price of today. She says her company needs dollars. We do the operation on Friday.
